a2f.codeIntro: To protect your account, enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
a2f.codeHint: 6 digits, or a backup code like ABCDE-FGHJK. Each backup code can be used once.
a2f.confirmHint: The 6 digits shown by the app after you added SideKey.
a2f.expired: Your sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.
a2f.enrolmentIntro: Two-factor authentication is required to access the back office. Set it up now, in three steps.
a2f.step1: Install an authenticator app (for example Aegis, FreeOTP or Google Authenticator).
a2f.step2: Scan the QR code below, or enter the key by hand.
a2f.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app to confirm.
a2f.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app to add SideKey
a2f.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:
a2f.codesWarning: Keep these 10 codes somewhere safe. They will never be shown again. Each one can be used once, if you lose access to your app.
a2f.codesDone: I have saved my codes, continue
